### 2. Erratum against PATCH 5

- PATCH 5 section 2 item 3 said deleting the standing demotion "and this control sees reused=1, parsed=1 and a
  receipt". **Wrong**, per N1. Deleting the demotion sends the member down the `Reused` arm, which reaches
  `population_parse_accepted` as well, so its roster arm refuses the declared key either way: `parsed` stays 0 and
  no receipt appears. What changes is `reused` becomes 1 and `miss_declared_refused` stays 0 — the control still
  reddens, on those two conjuncts. PATCH 5 section 2 item 3's second half (the counted arm and the roster arm
  predictions) is unaffected and stays as written.
- PATCH 5 section 2 item 4 quoted the receipt line as `"sha256:<digest> <compiler>"`. **Wrong**, per N2. The speller
  is `gunbc.parse_verdict_schema.parse_verdict_stored_accepted_line`, which emits
  `"parse-verdict" TAB source_digest TAB compiler TAB "Accepted"` — the constants are
  `parse_verdict_request_family = "parse-verdict"` and `parse_verdict_receipt_accepted = "Accepted"`. The
  relabelling stands on a stronger reason than the one I gave, stated in the file now:
  `parse_verdict_receipt_lines` keys its Map by `unicode_scalar_fold` of the whole LINE, so the artifact is a set of
  lines carrying no member identity at all and a key swap is not even expressible at this interface.

### 7. Extraction and verification recipe (exact)

`comment.md` is the raw body as stored by GitHub, e.g.
`gh api repos/gunb-ai/gunbc/issues/comments/COMMENT_ID --jq .body > comment.md`.

```
extract() { awk -v s="$1" '$0=="GZB64-BEGIN "s{f=1;next} $0=="GZB64-END "s{f=0} f' comment.md | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d | gzip -dc; }

extract section-5-commit-object > commit.raw
sha256sum commit.raw                                  # 3a7dfff31d329b6e8bacf1a4eef0174dab033c09b400a1d325a8952f0f9a7008
git hash-object -t commit --stdin < commit.raw        # 56ead5acee36dd72854f296a6e7fa39b934e87c4

extract section-6-cumulative-patch > cum.patch
sha256sum cum.patch                                   # 71ba2135abd5c88562edff2425918aa54b31ebebeff6013d3fb49b7fe635d732
git clone --no-checkout <repo-url> scratch && cd scratch
git fetch -q origin ed007978dc2a67096df619b1b91566458dfb2ffd && git checkout -q ed007978dc2a
git apply --check cum.patch && git apply cum.patch
git add -A && git write-tree                          # fa9c77c01883f4a723b3fd2bf4321a28d8089d01

# comment-only check over the delta, against PATCH 5
extract section-4-p5-to-p6-delta > delta.patch
grep -E '^[+-]' delta.patch | grep -v -E '^(\+\+\+|---)' \
  | sed 's/^.//' | grep -vE '^\s*(//|$)' | wc -l     # 0
```
